# Property-based testing (Trail of Bits)

Write and review property-based tests with Hypothesis, fast-check, proptest and more.

- Source: https://github.com/trailofbits/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trailofbits/skills/main/plugins/property-based-testing/skills/property-based-testing/SKILL.md
- Author: Trail of Bits
- License: CC-BY-SA-4.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/property-based-testing-trail-of-bits-eef7d2b2

Helps Claude test whole input domains rather than a few hand-picked examples. It offers a catalog of properties worth testing (round-trips, idempotence, ordering, invariants) for parsers, serializers, validators, numeric types and smart contracts. It also flags property tests that quietly assert nothing. Covers Hypothesis, fast-check, proptest, jqwik, rapid, and Echidna/Medusa for Solidity.

**Try asking:**
- "Add Hypothesis tests for my JSON encoder and decoder"
- "Are my fast-check tests actually checking anything?"
- "Write invariant tests for this ERC-20 contract"
